note: Where each stocked brand's official product images live and how to get them. Learned 2026-10-15 by scouting both shops' stock lists. Update when a site changes.
rules: Official brand image first. Never a retailer's copy, never anything generated or redrawn.
Look at the picture (contact sheet) before trusting a page title: Callaway's titles and headings disagree.
A standard model image for a custom build is saved with exact_build=false and shown as 'standard image'.
Nothing reaches the feed until a person approves it on the photo map.

Titleist.blocked: The image server returns 403 to anything but a real browser page. Found and checked in the browser, cannot be downloaded by a script. Needs a manual save or a different route.

Srixon.note: srixon.com US now errors; the Dunlop Sports Canada store carries Srixon's own images. 870px: run the faithful Topaz upscale before use.

Callaway.note: Listing pages hang a hidden browser pane; open product pages in a fresh tab. Titles and headings can disagree. 2026 images exist for chrome-tour, chrome-tour-x, chrome-tour-td, chrome-soft; confirm the stock generation. Quantum Mini (2026) image: .../sits/drivers-2026-quantum-mini/drivers-2026-quantum-mini___1.png?sw=2000.

Vice Golf.images: cdn.shopify.com dozen-box shots, full size when the width parameter is dropped
Vice Golf.note: Balls found. Clubs, bags and junior sets not found yet. Stock is sleeves; the site shows dozen boxes.

Takomo.note: 301 CB, MB and Combo are separate products; the stock just says '301'.

L.A.B. Golf.note: Standard black models only. Custom shaft and colour builds are not online.

Vessel.note: Full current catalogue incl. Player V Stand and Prime 2.0 Staff.

Mileseey.method: browser pane for the product list, og:image on each product page
Mileseey.images: img-va.myshopline.com, w=1600 (S1 source is 800px). Downloads fine from a script.
Mileseey.note: GenePro G1 and S1, GeneSonic Pro, IONME2 all found. Some images carry award badges (Red Dot, MyGolfSpy, TIME): crop before use.

Golf Pride.note: Opens in the pane once allowed. Product shots come from images.eaton.com with coded part numbers, not colour names, so colourways cannot be told apart from the page. Scripts get 403 (site) and no connection (eaton). Range-level photo is the realistic route.

GripDrip.images: 2400x1800 and larger, one product per colourway
GripDrip.note: The real store (gripdrip.com is parked). Names match the stock lists exactly, towels included.

RipIt.note: The feed does not tie an image to a colourway, so every colourway of a design gets the same picture. Use one design image per range; shoot the colourways.

Not scouted yet: Vice clubs, bags and junior sets (site has no product feed)
AJM GripCo, Lamkin, Icon, Star Grip, Pure Grip (no site found)
Titleist gloves, Vokey SM10, Scotty Cameron

Psycho Bunny.method: Shopify /products.json; match the style code in the title to the SKU prefix, then the Color option
Psycho Bunny.images: 1500x1870 on a grey background or on a model
Psycho Bunny.note: Current season only. Past-season styles (Denis and Dale graphic tees, Kingston polo, caps, umbrella, Top Grey) are gone from the site.

Herschel.note: Watt Stand, Watt Sunday, Watt Light Stand and Realtree versions.

TaylorMade.note: Qi10 fairway is a past model, not on the maker's site. Retailer pages only, so not used.

FootJoy.note: Opens in the pane once allowed. Glove pages found (StaSof, SciFlex, RainGrip, SofJoy, WeatherSof). Same Acushnet image server as Titleist: scripts get 403, so images can be seen but not downloaded.

Odyssey.method: browser pane (the site is on Callaway's platform); page og:image
Odyssey.note: Ai-One Double Wide CH, Rossie DB (US site) and Milled Seven T (Odyssey Europe page) found. Stock names do not give the hosel (CH or DB), so each is flagged to confirm. odysseygolf.com itself returns 429 to scripts; odyssey.callawaygolf.com works in the pane.

Ping.method: browser pane for the pages; images from api.next.ping.com/media/catalog/product/c/l/<file>.png
Ping.images: 1600x1600 PNG, top-down address views and angled face views; downloads from a script with a ping.com referrer
Ping.note: Anser 2D and DS72 each exist as PLD Milled, 2023 and Scottsdale versions and the stock name does not say which, so all three are saved as separate views per SKU (address-2023, address-scottsdale, face-pld-milled): approve one, reject the others. ping.com itself 404s plain requests.
